messages:
Nora: Quick roundup from today's design review: compare table still feels visually unbalanced. Badges on the right push metric values off-center on 1280px.
Ethan: Users flagged that too. Suggest we deprioritize "decorative" badges and keep 1-2 informative ones visible, collapse the rest behind a +n.
Lina: For the +n overflow, please ensure it expands inline (not a new modal). Keyboard focus should land on the first metric item when expanded.
Owen: Accessibility note: badges currently use color and icon only. Needs aria-labels like "Latency (p95): 120ms, good" and visible text in the expanded list.
Maya: Pin behavior confusion again: people think pin follows current filters. Its global. Propose a tiny inline chooser on pin: [Apply globally] [Apply to this view]. Default to "this view" to match expectations.
Nora: Also add a persistent header chip when anything is pinned: "Pinned: vX.Y.Z (scope)" so users don't lose context after changing filters.
Ethan: Motion: animate pin action with transform+opacity into the header chip. Keep duration <=160ms, use GPU-safe properties only.
Lina: Microcopy: change abbreviations in tooltips from "P95" to "Latency (p95)" and ensure the screen-reader string matches.
Owen: Touch targets: visual badge can be 20px but ensure tap area >=32px. CSS trick: negative margin + padding to increase hit area.
Maya: QA to confirm: pinned highlight persists across filter swaps, overflow expands inline and focuses correctly, and aria labels read full metric names.
UX-Bot: Reminder: add a11y checklist to PR template: contrast, aria-labels, keyboard focus order, hit target sizes.
Nora: Next steps: Ethan to prototype compact badges + +n overflow, Lina to add keyboard focus steps, Owen to draft a11y acceptance, Maya to update pin microcopy and header chip. Review Thurs 10am.
Ethan: I'll drop a Figma frame today and a short recording of the overflow interaction.
Lina: I'll test keyboard flow on VoiceOver once the frame is up.
Owen: I'll file bugs for the pinned highlight regression I saw in staging.
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
